reviews.text: my poor dog got a foxtail in his eye. we went to 3 different vets who didn’t work out for different reasons and we finally found beverly virgil. there was no wait, the lady at the front was so kind and helpful. the vet and technicians were lovely too. we even had them groom our dog and are so shoot with the results. oh and the prices were the best we found! i’d give 6 stars if i could 💛 i finally found a vet in LA i will be coming back to. thank you!!!
Been coming to this vet for over 20 years. The doctor is very honest. And the staff is the best. They’ve seen all my dogs I’ve had.
They take great care of my dog every time I bring him there. Recently had to have an extensive dental procedure performed on my pup. They did a great job and his smile is brighter than ever.
Thank you so much, Carolina for the 5 star rating!

The whole staff was rude it was my first time being back after their covid restrictions and they didn’t assist me on how they wanted to do the appointment the lady just assumed i knew what to do and then yanked my dog out of my hands to weigh him herself. Mind you this is my first dog i dont know how check ups work and how they do things here. I have been iffy on coming back because i didnt like the services and their routine on things. This place does charge alot for basic procedures and they dont let you know when they gonna charge you extra for your dog shittin or peeing out of fear. Then the doctor was only offering me the most expensive options when there was clearly a cheaper route for treatment! Please dont come here they need to work on how they treat customers!

This heartfelt review is long overdue...
For over 15 years, I’ve entrusted the care of my dogs to this wonderful practice, and they have consistently exceeded every expectation. The veterinarians and entire team go above and beyond with genuine compassion and expertise. They’ve guided me through every question, concern, and milestone with my three beloved dogs — always with patience, kindness, and the highest level of care.
We happily rely on them for everything: vaccinations, grooming, wellness visits, and all manner of dog-related needs. A special note of gratitude to the front-desk team — they are exceptionally warm, attentive, and truly make every visit feel special.
With deepest appreciation and continued loyalty — thank you for being our family’s trusted veterinary home all these years.

I'm extremely disappointed with the service I received from this animal hospital. They charged me extra for services I didn't even receive, and they never bothered to call me back after taking my cat's blood sample. I was left waiting for three days with no update on my cat's condition. As a first-time customer, I was taken aback when the lady asked us to leave without realizing the store's 11:30 closing time. She didn't even tell us what time they open the next day.

Unfortunately, Dr. Ryuu misled us about not charging for the second follow-up check for blood glucose levels, and they didn't provide clear explanations. WILL NEVER AGAIN COME
Fast service  .no apoimemt necessary  ( i was in the morning) down side if you are like my self this guy don't have time to remind you the next appointment

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this clinic deserves one.

At my cat’s first vaccination visit, I was clearly told that the second vaccine would be free, and that a flea treatment scheduled three months later would also be included at no cost.

When I returned for the follow-up visit, I was suddenly presented with multiple surprise charges that were never disclosed or explained beforehand. When I questioned this, the veterinarian dismissed my concern by saying that “making a mistake once isn’t a big deal.” There was no apology, no accountability, and no attempt to resolve the issue.

On top of that, during the first visit, I was told my cat had fleas — even though there had been no signs prior to that appointment. Flea treatment was administered, yet 2–3 weeks later the fleas were still present. When I called the clinic for guidance, I was told there was nothing they could do because medication had already been given. There was zero effort to help, advise, or take responsibility.

We ended up hiring a professional cleaning service, and despite that, the issue continued. Instead of offering support, the clinic shifted the blame entirely, claiming it must be the cleaning company’s fault. The attitude throughout this process was dismissive, careless, and borderline unbelievable.

This clinic shows a clear pattern: take the money, then take no responsibility. There is a serious lack of transparency, integrity, and basic professionalism.

I will not be returning, and I strongly warn others to get every promise and every charge in writing — because verbal assurances here clearly mean nothing.

We've been coming to Beverly Virgil for about 5 years now and both Dr. Kim and Dr. Ryu have been kind, straight forward, honest about the necessity of treatments and tests, and efficient. I have referred them to friends who have gotten much lower surgery price quotes than other places. They are also one of the few vets in LA where you can walk in and be seen that day. We'll keep coming back for our dog's regular care.
